Which drug and device companies paid doctors and teaching hospitals the most in 2023?

SELECT applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_making_payment_name, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many appeals arose from judgments entered in 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.originating_court_information WHERE substr(cast(date_judgment AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2024'
Which companies hold the most discontinued drug products?
SELECT applicant_full_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE ad_type = 'DISCN' AND applicant_full_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many registered clinical trials study breast cancer?
SELECT count(DISTINCT nct_id) AS trials FROM govblock_health.ct_conditions WHERE lower(condition) LIKE '%breast cancer%'
Which companies' shares did investment managers hold the most of by value at the end of 2024?

SELECT i.nameofissuer, round(sum(try_cast(i.value AS double))) AS reported_value FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_infotable i JOIN govblock_sec.sec_13f_submission b ON b.accession_number = i.accession_number WHERE b.periodofreport = '31-DEC-2024' AND coalesce(i.putcall, '') = '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did real GDP in Los Angeles County change from 2001 to 2024?
SELECT try_cast(_2001 AS double) AS in_2001, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS in_2024 FROM govblock_economy.bea_cagdp9 WHERE geofips = '06037' AND linecode = '1'
Which medical specialties write the most Medicare prescriptions for insulin glargine?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_type, sum(try_cast(tot_clms AS double)) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE gnrc_name LIKE 'Insulin Glargine%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many babies were born in Manhattan hospitals in 2016?

SELECT count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE hospital_county = 'Manhattan' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE '%newborn%' AND cast(discharge_year AS varchar) = '2016'
Which New York counties have the highest poverty rates?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_poverty FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US36%' AND a.table_id = 'b17001' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What definition does ChEBI give for serotonin?
SELECT definition FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_compounds WHERE name = 'serotonin'

r: A primary amino compound that is the 5-hydroxy derivative of tryptamine.

Which metropolitan areas have the highest median household income?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_income FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '310%' AND a.table_id = 'b19013' AND a.variable = 'B19013_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

r: San Jose-Sunnyvale-Santa Clara, CA Metro Area

How much federal assistance went to recipients in New York in fiscal year 2021?

SELECT sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE recipient_state_code = 'NY' AND cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2021'
Where is sub-award work carried out most, state by state?

SELECT place_of_perform_state_name, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE coalesce(place_of_perform_state_name, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did U.S. per capita personal income change from 2000 to 2024?
SELECT try_cast(_2000 AS double) AS in_2000, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS in_2024 FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE geofips = '00000' AND linecode = '3'
Which industry codes have the most companies filing quarterly reports in 2024?
SELECT sic, count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE form = '10-Q' AND cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many awards does a Grants.gov opportunity expect to make on average?
SELECT avg(try_cast(expectednumberofawards AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_awards.grantsgov_opportunity_synopsis WHERE try_cast(expectednumberofawards AS double) > 0
Which states have the most operating power plants on the national map?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_power_plants WHERE status = 'OP' AND state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was California's real GDP in the second quarter of 2020?
SELECT try_cast(y2020_q2 AS double) AS real_gdp_millions FROM govblock_economy.bea_sqgdp1 WHERE geoname = 'California' AND linecode = '1'
Which states have the most active FDIC-insured banks?
SELECT stalp, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE active = '1' AND stalp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Grants.gov opportunities mention climate in the title?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.grantsgov_opportunity_synopsis WHERE lower(opportunitytitle) LIKE '%climate%'
Which companies own the most transmission line segments?

SELECT replace(owner, '"', ''), count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_power_transmission_lines WHERE owner NOT LIKE '%NOT AVAILABLE%' AND replace(owner, '"', '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many compounds in PubChem carry a medical subject heading?
SELECT count(DISTINCT c0) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mesh
Which recalls covered the most vehicles?
SELECT max(mfgname) AS manufacturer, campno, max(compname) AS component, max(try_cast(potaff AS bigint)) AS vehicles FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls GROUP BY campno ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10
How many offshore wells were spudded in 2010?
Hifld Ocs Oil And Natural Gas Wells
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_ocs_oil_and_natural_gas_wells WHERE substr(replace(spud_date, '"', ''), 1, 4) = '2010'
Which agencies bought the most from small businesses in New York last fiscal year?

SELECT awarding_agency_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'NY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2025' AND contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size = 'SMALL BUSINESS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many registrants offer engineering and technical support services (PSC R425)?
SELECT count(DISTINCT unique_entity_id) AS n FROM govblock_awards.sam_entity_psc WHERE psc_code = 'R425'
Which states spent the most on energy in 2023?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS million_dollars FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'SEDS.TETCV.%.A' AND length(series_id) = 15 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) NOT IN ('US', 'X3', 'X5') AND period = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Do insiders hold the shares they trade directly or through trusts and other entities?

SELECT CASE direct_indirect_ownership WHEN 'D' THEN 'direct' WHEN 'I' THEN 'indirect' ELSE 'not stated' END AS ownership, count(*) AS transactions, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which U.S. patents have been cited most often by later patents?

SELECT p.patent_title, c.citation_patent_id, count(*) AS citations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_us_patent_citation c JOIN govblock_patents.pv_g_patent p ON p.patent_id = c.citation_patent_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Navy contract dollars in Virginia went to small businesses in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_sub_agency_name = 'DEPT OF THE NAVY' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'VA' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which stock exchanges list the most companies that file with the SEC?

SELECT json_extract_scalar(exchanges, '$[0]') AS exchange, count(*) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.submissions_companies WHERE json_extract_scalar(exchanges, '$[0]') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What do federal campaigns spend money on most, by category?
SELECT category_desc, sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which companies supply the most dry cask systems for storing spent nuclear fuel?
Dataset Waste Spent Fuel Storage Dry Cask Query 15
SELECT vendor, count(*) AS installations FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_waste_spent_fuel_storage_dry_cask_query_15 WHERE vendor <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which utilities sold the most electricity to industrial customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(sales_2 AS double) AS industrial_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
